req.title: Update task
req.statement: The system shall update mutable fields of the task and return the updated object when PUT /tasks/{task_id} is called with a valid body.

doc.reasoning: The test suite covers PUT /tasks/{task_id} across positive (valid full/partial updates), negative (missing task, invalid payloads), and boundary (max-length fields, min-length title, null description) cases. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill mutations on status codes, field values, and boolean flags. The pre-loaded dataset (20 rows) is used directly; the in-process TestClient drives the FastAPI app without any live URL calls. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact HTTP status codes, exact field values in the response body, and both sides of boolean fields (completed true/false).

tests.name: test_update_task_title_only_returns_200_with_updated_title
preconditions: Task id=7 exists with title='Fix login bug', completed=false
trace: R-TASK-010: mutable field title updated, object returned
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

create_r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Fix login bug', 'description': 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', 'completed': False})
assert create_r.status_code == 201
task_id = create_r.json()['id']

r = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'title': 'Fixed login bug'})
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.json()
assert body['id'] == task_id
assert body['title'] == 'Fixed login bug'
assert body['completed'] == False
assert body['description'] == 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.'
assert 'created_at' in body
